transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We need immediate genomic surveillance and widespread testing to determine true severity and transmissibility before acting blindly.

actions.rationale: We need immediate genomic surveillance and widespread testing to determine true severity and transmissibility before acting blindly.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions will buy us critical time to assess the threat while limiting seeding of new outbreaks.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions will buy us critical time to assess the threat while limiting seeding of new outbreaks.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: We must proactively surge production of PPE, tests, and ventilators now so we are not caught short if this escalates.

actions.rationale: We must proactively surge production of PPE, tests, and ventilators now so we are not caught short if this escalates.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: A crash public-private program for vaccines and therapeutics takes months to years; we cannot afford to wait for certainty to begin.

actions.rationale: A crash public-private program for vaccines and therapeutics takes months to years; we cannot afford to wait for certainty to begin.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Daily, honest, data-driven updates will build public trust and ensure Americans understand the evolving situation without panic.

actions.rationale: Daily, honest, data-driven updates will build public trust and ensure Americans understand the evolving situation without panic.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data portal is essential for governors, hospitals, and citizens to see real-time spread and coordinate responses.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data portal is essential for governors, hospitals, and citizens to see real-time spread and coordinate responses.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need to secure emergency funding and statutory authority now before the window for orderly legislative action closes.

actions.rationale: We need to secure emergency funding and statutory authority now before the window for orderly legislative action closes.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 57/100. Hospital strain 7/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 26/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Confirmed exponential spread with unknown severity; masking is a low-cost intervention that slows transmission without shutting down the economy.

actions.rationale: Confirmed exponential spread with unknown severity; masking is a low-cost intervention that slows transmission without shutting down the economy.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Regardless of where the true severity lands, shielding elderly and high-risk Americans now will prevent the worst outcomes while keeping broader society open.
